def paf_reference(r,k,prior,tolerance=1e-12):
    h=np.ones(len(r)) if prior==0 else np.clip(1-1/np.diag(np.linalg.inv(r)),0,1)
    for _ in range(10000):
        reduced=r.copy();np.fill_diagonal(reduced,h)
        e,v=np.linalg.eigh(reduced); order=np.argsort(e)[::-1][:k]; loadings=v[:,order]*np.sqrt(e[order])
        next_h=np.sum(loadings**2,axis=1)
        if np.max(abs(next_h-h))<=tolerance: h=next_h; break
        h=next_h
    reduced=r.copy();np.fill_diagonal(reduced,h);e,v=np.linalg.eigh(reduced);order=np.argsort(e)[::-1][:k]
    return v[:,order]*np.sqrt(e[order])

def mixture_nll(parameters):
